subproblem.title: A countable integer combination of oriented rectifiable pieces with finite total mass is integer multiplicity (Simon 3.8–3.9)
subproblem.statement: Assume (TL): for all P', n' ∈ ℕ, every open U' ⊆ ℝ^{P'} and all Borel A ⊆ B ⊆ U' with Hⁿ'(B ∩ C) < ∞ for every compact C ⊆ U', for Hⁿ'-a.e. x ∈ A and every subspace Q, B has approximate tangent space Q at x iff A does. Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and for j ∈ ℕ let N_j ⊆ U be Borel and countably n-rectifiable, g_j : ℝ^P → ℤ measurable with g_j(y) ≠ 0 for y ∈ N_j, and η_j : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) strongly measurable such that for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ N_j, η_j(y) is a unit orientation of an approximate tangent space of N_j at y. Assume Σ_j ∫⁻_{N_j} |g_j| dHⁿ < ∞ and let Q ∈ 𝒟_n(U) satisfy Q(ω) = Σ_j ∫_{N_j} g_j(y)·η_j(y)(ω(y)) dHⁿ(y) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then Q is integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity Q).
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (N : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (g : ℕ → Euclid P → ℤ) (η : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (Q : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (N j)) → (∀ j, N j ⊆ U) → (∀ j, CountablyRectifiable n (N j)) → (∀ j, Measurable (g j)) → (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ N j, g j y ≠ 0) → (∀ j, StronglyMeasurable (η j)) → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict (N j)), ∃ T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (N j) y T ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η j y) T) → ∑' j, ∫⁻ y in N j, ((g j y).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Q ω = ∑' j, ∫ y in N j, (g j y : ℝ) * η j y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y) ∂μHE[n]) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Q
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 8 (N and its finite measure), 9 (common tangent planes and the orientation η), 10 (the integer multiplicity k and dominated convergence) and 11 (the triple) of the parent proof, Simon 3.7–3.9; the final triple is built by the sibling imrep_of_density (accepted cmcdt_ims_imrep_of_int_density), which takes the carrier {k ≠ 0}, multiplicity |k| and orientation sign(k)η exactly as in step 11. Siblings used: orient_algebra, imrep_of_density, int_density.
1. The union. N := ⋃_j N_j is Borel, N ⊆ U, and N is countably n-rectifiable (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.countablyRectifiable_iUnion). Since g_j is a nonzero integer on N_j, |g_j| ≥ 1 there, so Hⁿ(N) ≤ Σ_j Hⁿ(N_j) ≤ Σ_j ∫⁻_{N_j} |g_j| dHⁿ < ∞; in particular Hⁿ(N ∩ C) < ∞ for every compact C ⊆ U.
2. Tangent planes of N. Fix j. (TL) with (U, A := N_j, B := N) (N_j ⊆ N ⊆ U Borel, step 1) gives: for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ N_j and every subspace T, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N y T ⟺ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N_j y T. With the hypothesis on η_j: (O_j) for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ N_j there is T with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N y T and η_j(y) a unit orientation of T. Consequently (ae_restrict_iUnion_iff, ae_all_iff, and N_i ∩ N_j ⊆ N_j): for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ N, (O_j) holds at y for every j with y ∈ N_j. Call such y good.
3. Common orientation. Lean instance note: PseudoMetrizableSpace (MultiVector P n) is not found by instance search; provide it by haveI : TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace (MultiVector P n) := @PseudoEMetricSpace.pseudoMetrizableSpace (MultiVector P n) inferInstance, after which TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace (MultiVector P n) is inferred; avoid finite sums of MultiVector-valued functions (ContinuousAdd is not found by instance search). For y ∈ N let j₀(y) be the least j with y ∈ N_j and put η(y) := η_{j₀(y)}(y); put η(y) := 0 for y ∉ N. Strong measurability: with the disjoint Borel sets D_j := N_j ∖ ⋃_{i<j} N_i (⋃_j D_j = N) define u_0 := 0 and u_{k+1}(y) := η_k(y) if y ∈ D_k, u_{k+1}(y) := u_k(y) otherwise; each u_k is strongly measurable (StronglyMeasurable.ite), and for each y the sequence u_k(y) is eventually equal to η(y) (from k = j₀(y) + 1 on if y ∈ N, constantly 0 otherwise), so η is strongly measurable (stronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto). For good y, (O_{j₀(y)}) says that η(y) is a unit orientation of an approximate tangent space of N at y; so this holds for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ N.
4. Signs. For j ∈ ℕ let ε_j(y) := 1 if η_j(y) = η(y) and ε_j(y) := −1 otherwise (ℤ-valued); ε_j is measurable because {η_j = η} is measurable (StronglyMeasurable.measurableSet_eq_fun, using the metrizable instance of step 3). If y is good and y ∈ N_j, then (O_j) and (O_{j₀(y)}) give approximate tangent spaces T, T' of N at y oriented by η_j(y) and η(y); by uniqueness (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique) T = T', so by orient_algebra (a) η_j(y) = η(y) or η_j(y) = −η(y), i.e. η_j(y) = ε_j(y)·η(y). Hence for every j, η_j = ε_j·η Hⁿ-a.e. on N_j.
5. The integer density. Let f_j := 1_{N_j}·ε_j·g_j : ℝ^P → ℤ (measurable; |f_j| = 1_{N_j}|g_j|), so Σ_j ∫⁻ |f_j| dHⁿ = Σ_j ∫⁻_{N_j} |g_j| dHⁿ < ∞. int_density gives a measurable m : ℝ^P → ℝ, integer valued at every point, with |m(y)| ≤ S(y) := Σ_j |f_j(y)| for every y and, for Hⁿ-a.e. y, (f_j(y))_j summable with m(y) = Σ_j f_j(y). Hence ∫⁻_{N∩C} |m| dHⁿ ≤ ∫⁻ S dHⁿ = Σ_j ∫⁻_{N_j} |g_j| dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact C (lintegral_tsum).
6. Representation. Let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) and C_ω := sup_y ‖ω(y)‖ < ∞ (ω is continuous with compact support). By orient_algebra (b) and the a.e. orientation properties, |η_j(y)(ω(y))| ≤ C_ω for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ N_j and |η(y)(ω(y))| ≤ C_ω for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ N. Then: (i) by step 4, ∫_{N_j} g_j·η_j(ω) dHⁿ = ∫_{N_j} g_j·ε_j·η(ω) dHⁿ = ∫_N f_j·η(ω) dHⁿ (N_j ⊆ N, f_j = 0 off N_j); (ii) the functions f_j·η(ω) are a.e. strongly measurable on N and Σ_j ∫⁻_N |f_j·η(ω)| dHⁿ ≤ C_ω·Σ_j ∫⁻_{N_j} |g_j| dHⁿ < ∞, so integral_tsum gives Σ_j ∫_N f_j·η(ω) dHⁿ = ∫_N Σ_j f_j(y)·η(y)(ω(y)) dHⁿ(y); (iii) for Hⁿ-a.e. y, (f_j(y)) is summable with sum m(y) (step 5), so Σ_j f_j(y)·η(y)(ω(y)) = m(y)·η(y)(ω(y)) (tsum_mul_right). With the hypothesis on Q: Q(ω) = Σ_j ∫_{N_j} g_j·η_j(ω) dHⁿ = ∫_N m(y)·η(y)(ω(y)) dHⁿ(y).
7. The triple. imrep_of_density with (U, N, η, m): U is open, N is Borel, N ⊆ U, N is countably n-rectifiable and Hⁿ(N ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U (step 1), η is strongly measurable (step 3), m is measurable and integer valued (step 5), ∫⁻_{N∩K} |m| dHⁿ < ∞ (step 5), and for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ N, η(y) is a unit orientation of an approximate tangent space of N at y (step 3). It gives an IMRep R' in U with R'.action(ω) = ∫_N m·η(ω) dHⁿ for every n-form ω. By step 6, Q(ω) = R'.action(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), i.e. R' represents Q. Hence IsIntegerMultiplicity Q. ∎
proof_key_steps: N := ⋃N_j is Borel, rectifiable, Hⁿ(N) ≤ Σ∫|g_j| < ∞ since |g_j| ≥ 1 on N_j.
(TL) for N_j ⊆ N transfers the oriented approximate tangent planes of N_j to N a.e.; uniqueness makes them common.
η := η_{first j} (built recursively with StronglyMeasurable.ite) is strongly measurable and orients T_yN a.e.; orient_algebra (a) gives η_j = ε_j η a.e. on N_j.
int_density applied to f_j = 1_{N_j}ε_j g_j gives a measurable integer-valued m with |m| ≤ Σ|f_j| and m = Σ f_j a.e.
integral_tsum (dominated by C_ω Σ|g_j|1_{N_j}) gives Q(ω) = ∫_N m η(ω); imrep_of_density yields an IMRep representing Q.
